scope: Windows-only native tray for the embedded web owner; no complete release or model-editing acceptance claim

implementation.platform_guards: Library and test targets are inside if(WIN32); declarations and implementation use _WIN32. Shared entry signature and invocation are in existing Windows-only branches.
implementation.icon: Native supersampled gradient X; no new runtime assets or third-party dependency
implementation.owner: One icon per production embedded web owner, never per CLI/IPC client or worker
implementation.quit: Confirmation before calling the existing server.stop shutdown path
implementation.lifecycle: Dedicated native message thread, Explorer TaskbarCreated recovery, icon/window removal at owner shutdown
implementation.browser_address: Canonical public loopback /ui/ URL only; no credential or query string
implementation.headless: Absent notification area does not prevent the web backend from serving

validation.actual_tray_contract: passed 0.11s: Shell_NotifyIconGetRect verifies real registration, hidden window, simulated self-only Explorer notification recovery and cleanup; rejects invalid/nonlocal addresses
validation.non_windows: Guard/path review only; no Linux or macOS build was run
validation.live_menu_clicks: Not performed: computer control was stopped by the user's Escape key; no further Computer Use calls were made

live_delivery.handoff: Authenticated native managed upgrade; same profile, URL and saved sessions; no prompt or tool replay

revised_design.icon: Three connected thought nodes, white/cyan on a rounded indigo tile; no X or lettering
revised_design.activation: Mouse click, right-click and keyboard selection open the menu; browser opens only from explicit Open web UI selection
revised_design.removed: Copy web UI address and all clipboard code
revised_design.scope: Windows-only icon/menu revision; no model inference or replay; no new live interactive menu-click acceptance claimed
